text.en:
OF COMMONWEALTH ACT NO. 567.
WhEREAS, upon consideration of the petition of the
Central Santos-Lopez Co., Inc., for waiver of the pro-
gressive tax upon sugar centrals and sugar mill operators,
it was found that said sugar central is heavily indebted
and is operating on borrowed capital which has been
utilized for rehabilitation purposes; that the total sugar
allotment for the district assigned to said central has.
not been. fully covered because of conditions and cit-
cumstances beyond its control, and that during the crop
year 1949-1950, it produced only 39 per cent of its total
quota allotment; and
WHEREAS, under the circumstances above set forth, it
would be oppressive and confiscatory to impose upon said
sugar central the progressive tax provided by Common-
wealth Act No. 567 for the crop year 1949-1950;
Now, THEREFORE, I, Elpidio Quirino, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by
law, do hereby Waive for the crop year 1949-1950 the.
additional progressive tax to be paid by the Central Santos-
Lopez Co., Inc., under section 2 of Commonwealth Act
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of June, in
the vear of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-one, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Assistant Executive Secretary
